evals.prompt: fixtures/public/sample.dsd 내용을 읽기 좋은 마크다운으로 만들어 줘.
evals.hard_because: Generic unzip shows mojibake image names and raw XML; &cr; tokens, editor comments, and span tables need DSD-specific handling.
evals.expected_output: Runs inspect/outline, then read -o beside the source (sample.md plus sample.assets/). The Markdown keeps section headings, renders the rowspan/colspan shareholder table as HTML, turns &cr; into line breaks, omits ◆click◆ scaffolding, and links the image. Does not upload or paste the full document elsewhere.

evals.prompt: sample.dsd 재무상태표에서 당기 현금및현금성자산을 1,100,000으로 바꿔줘. 원본은 그대로 두고.
evals.hard_because: The figure must be located by table/row/column; totals depend on it, and a regenerated XML or re-zip would corrupt CP949 image names.
evals.expected_output: Locates T3R4C2 with find/table, writes a new file with set-cell, leaves the original untouched, runs check --against and diff showing exactly one changed cell, and reports that 유동자산 (T3R3C2) and 자산총계 (T3R6C2) now disagree with the new figure unless the user asked to update them.

evals.prompt: Change the reporting period end in sample.dsd to 2026-12-31.
evals.hard_because: The cover date is a TU cell whose AUNITVALUE must change with the display text.
evals.expected_output: Uses set-cell on T1R2C1 with --text '2026년 12월 31일' and --unit-value 20261231, considers the period-start cell and other period references, and verifies with check (no unit-value warning) and diff.

evals.prompt: sample.dsd 주주 현황 표에 '김철수 / 0 / 0.00%' 행을 추가해 줘.
evals.hard_because: Row copying must respect ROWSPAN headers and keep TE ACODE attributes.
evals.expected_output: Copies a body row of T4 (not a header row inside the ROWSPAN) with copy-row --clear or an apply batch, fills the three cells with set-cell, writes a new file, and verifies check/diff. Does not hand-build the row with an XML library.

evals.hard_because: Bulk replacement can hit TU cells whose AUNITVALUE also needs changing, and overwriting the source needs explicit authority, which this request gives.
evals.expected_output: Runs replace --dry-run to see every occurrence (including the two TU cover dates, flagged as keeping their AUNITVALUE), replaces with the verified --expect count or uses set-cell --unit-value for the TU cells so machine values follow, writes with --force to the source only because the user asked to overwrite, and reports TU machine values and other period dependents.

evals.prompt: 이 DSD 파일 구조만 알려줘. 내용은 보여주지 마.
evals.hard_because: Confidential content must not be echoed.
evals.expected_output: Uses inspect (and outline only if headings are acceptable), reporting versions, member list, counts, and issues without quoting document text.
